title: French Smoked Salmon Tartine
description: A simple yet elegant French-inspired open-faced sandwich featuring smoked salmon, apple, and flaky pastry.

ingredients.name: Smoked salmon
ingredients.notes: Look for high-quality smoked salmon with a rich flavor

ingredients.name: Apple
ingredients.notes: Granny Smith or other firm variety works well

ingredients.name: Flaky pastry
ingredients.notes: Puff pastry or similar flaky pastry works well

instructions: Roll out the pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch and place on a baking sheet.
Spread a thin layer of olive oil over the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Bake the pastry for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, toast the apple slices by placing them on a separate baking sheet and baking for 5-7 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
To assemble the tartine, place a slice of the toasted pastry on a serving plate or bowl, top with a slice of smoked salmon, and a few slices of toasted apple.
Drizzle with a bit of olive oil and serve immediately.
